MUTUAL AGREEMENT (IMG20260921234054.jpg.jpeg)

1. TERM AND TERMINATION
1.1. Either party may terminate this agreement upon thirty (30) days written notice.

2. PAYMENT
2.1. Invoices are payable within net 30 days of receipt.

3. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
3.1. In no event shall either party's liability exceed the total contract price paid.
